issueTitle: FloatingOverlay react component causes visible scrolling on iOS when the scroll behaviour of its container is 'smooth'

files.createContent:
---
'@floating-ui/react': patch
---

Prevent iOS scroll restoration from visibly animating when the document uses smooth scrolling.

plan.commitMessage: fix(react): restore iOS overlay scroll instantly
plan.prTitle: fix(react): restore overlay scroll instantly on iOS
plan.prBody:
Fixes #3464.

`FloatingOverlay` uses fixed body positioning to implement `lockScroll` on iOS, then restores the previous page position during cleanup. The current positional `window.scrollTo(scrollX, scrollY)` call can inherit the document's `scroll-behavior: smooth`, causing the viewport to jump to the top and visibly animate back to its saved position when the overlay closes.

Pass an explicit `behavior: 'instant'` when restoring the saved coordinates so cleanup remains an immediate state restoration regardless of the page's smooth-scroll styling. This only changes the existing iOS cleanup path and does not affect overlay positioning or non-iOS scroll locking.

A patch changeset for `@floating-ui/react` is included.
plan.testEvidence: Validated the patch against the current `packages/react/src/components/FloatingOverlay.tsx` iOS cleanup path and confirmed the change is limited to the saved-coordinate restoration call. The reported visual regression is iOS-specific and cannot be faithfully executed in the ContributorOps runner; upstream CI plus maintainer/reporter verification on iOS Safari is requested before merge.
